translation_en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, Muhammad ibn Rafi', and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us. Ibn Rafi' said: 'Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us; the other two said: 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us: Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Malik ibn Aws ibn al-Hadathan, who said: 'Umar ibn al-Khattab sent for me and said that families from my people had arrived. He related something like Malik's hadith, except that it says: He used to provide his family from it for one year. Ma'mar sometimes said: He kept his family's provisions from it for one year, then made whatever remained a part of the property of Allah, Mighty and Exalted.

Yahya ibn Yahya said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwah, from 'A'ishah, who said: When the Messenger of Allah died, his wives wanted to send 'Uthman ibn 'Affan to Abu Bakr to ask him for their inheritance from the Prophet. 'A'ishah said to them: Did the Messenger of Allah not say: We are not inherited; what we leave is charity?
